slides.headline: 1) PASTE YOUR MEDICAL BILL
slides.body: He pasted a $1,200 hospital bill into Claude. It dropped to $180. "Here is my medical bill. Find every overcharge and write me a dispute letter citing fair market rates"

slides.headline: 2) SNAP YOUR LIVING ROOM
slides.body: She uploaded one living room photo. ChatGPT returned a full redesign and shopping list under $500. "Here is my living room. Redesign it modern minimalist, list everything to buy, all under $500"

slides.headline: 3) DROP IN THE JOB LISTING
slides.body: He gave Claude a job listing. It ran mock interviews with real critiques. He got the job. "Here is the role and my resume. Interview me one question at a time, critique each answer"

slides.headline: 4) PHOTOGRAPH WHAT YOU WANT TO SELL
slides.body: She snapped photos of things collecting dust. ChatGPT priced, listed, and wrote replies for lowball offers. "Here are items to sell. Price each, write a listing, and draft replies for lowball offers"

slides.headline: 5) HAND AI YOUR SLIDES
slides.body: She uploads her slides before every meeting. Claude predicts the exact questions her boss will ask. "Here is my presentation. Act as my toughest boss, list every question you would ask, hardest first"

slides.headline: 6) SCAN YOUR NEXT CONTRACT
slides.body: A freelancer uploads every contract before signing. Claude flags hidden fees and traps. "Here is a contract I'm about to sign. Flag anything that could cost me money or lock me in"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when you need them. Save this post. We share daily AI skills you can use tonight

caption:
Swipe for 6 things to upload to AI that save money, land jobs, and catch traps nobody reads 📱

A $1,200 medical bill fought down to $180 with one upload, a living room photo turned into a professional redesign with a shopping list under $500, a job listing that became mock interview practice and landed the job, photos of unused stuff turned into priced marketplace listings with negotiation scripts, slides that predicted every question the boss would ask, and a contract scanned for hidden fees before signing.

Most people type words into AI. The ones saving real money are uploading their actual bills, photos, and contracts. Every prompt here works tonight, free, on ChatGPT or Claude.
